statements.impact_statement: The image has no consumer outside the cryptography package that calls pkcs7_decrypt_der, pkcs7_decrypt_pem, or pkcs7_decrypt_smime, and it does not expose an attacker-controlled PKCS#7 EnvelopedData decryption service.

The CVE CNA record classifies cryptography <49.0.0 as affected, while the current GitHub advisory package range says <=48.0.0; this assessment conservatively treats 48.0.1 as affected. The image has no consumer outside cryptography that references cryptography.x509.verification, PolicyBuilder, build_client_verifier, or build_server_verifier, and the reviewed Azure CLI command paths do not expose attacker-controlled certificate-chain validation. The image build rechecks all installed consumer files and this assessment expires on 2026-09-15.
